integrity.statement: The proof is uniform over arbitrary coefficient fields; finite computations are cross-checks, not the proof of the infinite family.

scientific_limitations: The theorem specifies integral homology groups, not homotopy type or a group action.
Only path ladders are covered, not circular ladders or other graph families.
Bibliographic uniqueness is provisional; a differently indexed equivalent topology result may exist.
title: Integral homology of general-position complexes of ladder graphs
